scoring_justification: Percentages are recomputed from the raw strength increments provided by the agent and compared to the paper's explicitly reported approximate contributions (~80%, ~14%, ~6%) using an absolute tolerance of ±5 percentage points, providing a genuine recompute-based verification.

hidden_assets.purpose: Target percentage contributions for load sharing, Hall-Petch, and Orowan strengthening in PA Ti-64-1.6B.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper (JOM 2004, doi:10.1007/s11837-004-0131-5), section MECHANICAL PROPERTIES: "The majority of the strengthening (~80%) derives from the load sharing mechanism ... Hall-Petch strengthening (~14%) due to grain refinement and Orowan (~6%) strengthening".
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published article text as approximate percentages.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are explicitly quoted as approximate percentages in the published paper.

outputs.description: JSON object containing the predicted strength increments from load sharing, Hall-Petch, and Orowan mechanisms, plus the sum.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compute the percentage contribution of each mechanism (increment / total * 100) and compare each to hidden reference values derived from the paper within a tolerance. The output file must contain the four numeric fields.
